pages.text: Park roughly above a $(bold)folded jack$(reset), then use it. The platform rises and checks space at the end of the animation before restoring the wagon to blocks.$(br2)Clear room for the whole wagon and move standing or sleeping passengers aside. If space is blocked, the jack folds again; clear it and retry.

Restoration preserves cargo, contents, materials and equipment states. Seated riders dismount; draft animals detach and return leads.$(br2)In block form, breaking any component cell recovers that entire part. Breaking the box or jack cascades through attached parts and cargo. Axes are effective on wooden parts.
